text: Banks in the EU and UK are under pressure to demonstrate their operational readiness for the upcoming move to next day settlement, with just one year to go before the deadline for T+1.

title: Sibos 2026: Is USD's position as prime global currency in jeopardy?
text: Many global currency and trade experts have been wondering for a while now whether the US dollar might lose its luster as the world’s reserve or preferred cross-border payments and trade or asset management settlement currency. But a panel of bankers and foreign exchange experts gathering at Sibos 2026 in Miami all agreed the answer to that question is "not yet."
